summary: Run source signal abort steps before newly-aborted dependent signals' abort steps.

source.pattern: internal: signal abort with dependent signals

target.notes: Reuse the existing DOM EventTarget subsystem for listener registration/dispatch; this rule owns AbortSignal-specific state and abort algorithms.

semantics.ordering: source abort algorithms/event complete before abort steps for collected dependent signals
semantics.reason: dependent reasons are assigned before source abort steps

references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § AbortController / AbortSignal

tests.name: dependent already has reason during source event
